rationale: The material prompt requirement is serviceable market sizing with defensible share and sensitivity ranges. At # Revenue Modeling, the source is scoped to Builds SaaS revenue models - a reconciling MRR/ARR bridge, cohort retention forecasting, a driver tree from leads to new ARR, and base/upside/downside scenarios. Use when someone asks "model my ARR for next year", "what will MRR be if churn doubles", "build a revenue forecast for the board", "why do; it provides a meaningful neighbouring route but does not establish serviceable market sizing with defensible share and sensitivity ranges as required by the prompt.
